title: Alternating String
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq N, Q\leq 5\times 10^5; S is a string of length N consisting of 0 and 1.; 1\leq L\leq R\leq N for queries of types 1 and 2.; There is at least one query of type 2.; N, Q, L, and R are integers.
